title: Ecommerce Pricing & Repricing Strategist
description:
## We’re Hiring: Ecommerce Pricing & Repricing Strategist

\*\*Working hours: UK shift\*\*

We are looking for an analytical, detail-oriented professional to manage pricing and repricing across our ecommerce business. You will use AI-based repricing tools, research competitor prices, and make informed pricing decisions that grow sales while protecting profitability.

\*\*Key Responsibilities\*\*

- Research market prices and compare competitor offers across online marketplaces and websites.

- Manage and monitor AI-based repricing tools, including pricing rules, minimum prices, and margin targets.

- Maintain accurate pricing and competitor data in Google Sheets and Excel.

- Analyse product costs, marketplace fees, and margins to recommend profitable selling prices.

- Identify pricing errors, changes in competitor activity, and opportunities to improve sales.

- Review repricing results and adjust strategies based on performance.

- Work closely with purchasing and sales teams to keep prices competitive.

\*\*What We’re Looking For\*\*

- Strong analytical skills and confidence working with numbers.

- Good spreadsheet skills, including formulas, lookups, filters, and pivot tables.

- Excellent attention to detail and the ability to work accurately with large product lists.

- Patience and consistency with repetitive, detailed research.

- Commercial judgement: understanding how pricing affects sales and profit.

- Ownership of tasks, clear communication, and reliable follow-through.

- Availability to work UK business hours.

\*\*Preferred Experience\*\*

- Pricing experience on \*\*Amazon, eBay, and Shopify\*\*.

- Experience with AI-based or automated repricing software.

- Understanding of Amazon Buy Box competition, marketplace fees, and profit margins.

\*\*Please understand the nature of this role:\*\* A significant part of the work involves manually finding, checking, and recording market prices. Some tasks are repetitive and time-consuming, so you must enjoy detailed analysis and remain accurate throughout. AI tools support the work, but your judgement and attention to detail are essential.

\*\*To apply:\*\* Please send your CV with a short summary of your spreadsheet skills, relevant pricing experience, repricing tools used, and availability to work UK hours.

title: Data Science Trainer
description:
TECHWINGSYS is looking for a Data Science Trainer with strong knowledge of Python and Data Science to join our training team.
  
The trainer will be responsible for delivering engaging training sessions, assisting students with practical exercises and projects, and supporting their overall learning journey in Data Science, Python, and Machine Learning.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Deliver structured and engaging training sessions on Python and Data Science.
* Explain Data Science concepts clearly through practical, real-world examples.
* Assist students with practical exercises, assignments, and projects.
* Provide individual guidance and support to help students understand core concepts.
* Help students build real-time projects and professional portfolios.
* Conduct assessments, evaluations, and practical reviews to track student performance.
* Identify learning gaps and provide appropriate support to students.
* Guide students in applying Python and Data Science concepts to real-world problems.
* Stay updated with the latest trends, tools, technologies, and developments in Data Science and Machine Learning.
* Support students in developing problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Maintain a positive, professional, and engaging learning environment.

**Required Skills & Knowledge**

* Strong knowledge of Python programming.
* Good understanding of Data Science concepts and fundamentals.
* Familiarity with Data Science libraries such as:
* NumPy
* Pandas
* Matplotlib
* Basic understanding of Data Analysis, Data Visualization, and Machine Learning concepts.
* Ability to explain technical concepts in a simple and understandable manner.
* Good communication and presentation skills.
* Passion for teaching, mentoring, and helping students grow.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related field.
* Certification in Data Science or Python will be an added advantage.

**Experience**

* 0–2 years of relevant experience in Data Science, Python development, training, or a related field.
* Freshers with strong practical knowledge and good communication skills may also be considered.

**What We Look For**

* Strong technical fundamentals
* Practical, project-oriented approach
* Good communication and mentoring ability
* Willingness to continuously learn and upgrade technical skills
* Ability to work with students from different learning levels

**Language:**
Fluency in Malayalam is mandatory. Good English communication skills are also required.
  
**Salary:**
₹16,000–₹25,000 per month, depending on practical skills, communication, and experience.
